steps.message:
This is a one-line value change, but session lifetime is a security-posture setting, so I want your explicit yes before editing rather than after.

`config.js:3` is `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30`, consumed by `server.js` as the session expiry. Going to 480 makes a stolen or unattended session valid for a full workday instead of half an hour — 16x the window in which a hijacked session cookie, a shared machine, or an unlocked laptop stays usable. Nothing else in the repo compensates for that (no idle timeout, no re-auth on sensitive actions).
